name: Retell AI
summary: Platform for voice AI agents that answer, qualify and book appointments on phone calls.
description: Retell AI deploys voice agents that handle real phone calls, including call transfer, appointment booking, knowledge-base answers, IVR navigation and batch outbound campaigns. It provides post-call analysis and quality assurance, and lists HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance. Pricing starts at $0 with pay-as-you-go billing, and new accounts receive $10 of free credits. Agents can also use a branded caller ID and verified phone numbers to avoid spam flags.
